role: evaluation data for the prompt-defined runtime; nothing here is compiled into the image
system_prompt: Classify the observation. Reply with exactly safe or danger.

cases.observation: The machine is stopped, electrical power is isolated, and the safety guard is closed.
The hazard zone is empty and the locked gate remains closed during operation.
Maintenance is in progress with lockout and tagout applied and zero stored energy verified.
The robot is in a verified idle state and no person is inside its fenced workspace.
The pressure vessel is isolated, depressurized, and confirmed at zero pressure before access.
The conveyor is stopped and cleared, and its emergency stop has been tested before inspection.
A person is inside the hazard zone while the machine is moving.
The safety guard is open and its interlock has been bypassed while the motor is energized.
A worker is loosening a fitting while the line remains pressurized.
A worker entered the robot cell while automatic motion is enabled.
Exposed live conductors are within reach and electrical power has not been isolated.
An operator is reaching into a running conveyor to remove a jam.
